html:
Thomas is in his final year of a Bachelor of Laws at University of Sydney. He has long aspired to practise in family law.

Thomas’s passion for family law comes from a desire to provide clients with support and guidance during difficult family circumstances. He is committed to helping clients navigate challenging situations with empathy, reassurance, and practical advice.
